Values %: Nagini / Velvet / Lean / EARS (Table 2, SWE-bench Verified, n = 500). Tokens = input tokens per episode (Table 41, Nagini unless noted).
- Row 0 unaided baseline (no spec): 85.0 (all); 200k
- Row 1 baseline + counterexample audit: 58.2 (shows test incompleteness)
- Row 2 end-to-end, agent writes spec (graded on tests): 85.6 / 85.0 / 83.8 / 84.2; 438k (EARS 326k)
- Row 3 verified end-to-end (self-written spec must verify): 84.0 / 85.4 / 84.6 / 57.2; 438k (EARS 301k)
- Row 4 localization provided (no spec): 88.2; 140k
- Row 5 verified from localization: 92.0 / 91.8 / 89.6 / 64.6
- Row 6 ground-truth spec provided: 96.2 / 94.0 / 95.2 / 97.8; 376k
- Row 7 verified from provided spec: 95.0 / 94.0 / 93.6 / 80.0; 354k
- Row 8 spec synthesis audit pass: 46.0 / 60.0 / 61.4 / N/A; 335k
- SWE-bench Pro (n = 242, Table 19), same rows: R0 61.2; R1 17.4; R2 50.8/49.2/50.0/50.8; R3 49.6/50.0/47.9/12.4; R4 61.2; R5 52.9/52.1/53.7/19.4; R6 55.8/59.9/58.7/73.1; R7 56.2/55.0/58.7/31.4; R8 31.0/35.5/49.2

Verdicts: quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors (all configurations)
fields.why: Extractor's cut-offs (quality >= 90 / 60-90 / < 60; cost <= 250k / 250-450k tokens) and the verdicts based on them removed: the authors state no success criterion for quality or cost; metric values kept (rule 1)
